visual_goal: Show market, condition, battery, history and connected evidence flowing into Vantage, valuations flowing out to decisions, and outcomes flowing back through the valuation ledger as per-segment bias.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Left column, four evidence boxes top to bottom: a small line chart labeled 'Pulse', a car panel outline with a magnifier labeled 'Gauge', a battery icon labeled 'Battery health', and a clock-style history scroll labeled 'Tracewell'. Further left of 'Battery health' and 'Tracewell', a small car with a signal wave labeled 'Connected readings', with one arrow into 'Battery health' and one arrow into 'Tracewell' labeled 'promoted readings'. Center: a large balance scale labeled 'Vantage', with one arrow into it from each of 'Pulse', 'Gauge', 'Battery health' and 'Tracewell'. Right: a document with a handshake icon labeled 'Offers', with one arrow from 'Vantage' to 'Offers' labeled 'range, comparables, confidence'. Below 'Offers': a ledger book labeled 'Valuation ledger', with one arrow from 'Offers' down to it labeled 'what happened next'. One orange arrow from 'Valuation ledger' back left along the bottom into 'Vantage', labeled 'bias per segment'. These eleven labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Pulse, Gauge, battery health and Tracewell feed Vantage; connected readings feed battery health and Tracewell; Vantage sends ranges to offers, outcomes go to the valuation ledger, and bias per segment flows back to Vantage.
